summary.text: T.J. Marti is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 75 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Marti, whom Ballotpedia lists as T. Marti and says is also known as T.J., took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Karen Gaddis.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances and the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee.
Joe Watkins, a Democrat, is his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
